sutta: 3.2.2 suta this was said by the Lord monks there are these three elements what three the form element the formless element and the element of Association these are the three by fully understanding the form element without getting stuck in the formless they are released into cessation and leave that far behind them having touch with his own person the deathless element free from clinging having realized a relinquishment of clinging his asavas all gone the fully enlightened one proclaims the sorrowless state that is void of staying this form element can refer to the can refer to the form Realm understanding the form realm and not getting stuck on the homeless releasing two associations Association normally refers to Association of perception and feeling
